items.title: Nicole Scherzinger and Thom Evans Split After 7 Years of Dating
items.summary:
Nicole Scherzinger and fiancé Thom Evans have ended their relationship after seven years together.

“It is with a heavy heart that I share that Nicole and I are no longer together,” Evans, 41, wrote via his Instagram Story on Friday, November 27. “After seven years of love, commitment and believing in a future together, this is an incredibly difficult time.”

He continued: “Whilst this is not the outcome I had ever hoped for, I respect Nicole’s decision and genuinely wish her every happiness in the next chapter of her life. Thom x.”

Scherzinger, 48, for her part, has yet to publicly address the breakup.

Most Shocking Celebrity Splits 

The former couple met in 2019 on the set of The X Factor: Celebrity . They began dating later that year but didn’t go public with their romance until a Golden Globe Awards afterparty red carpet in 2020.

“It wasn’t even in my thought process to try it on with Nicole because it would have been unprofessional, and she’s so lovely and stunning in every possible way,” Evans told The Sun in 2021. “I was just like, ‘She’s out of my league.'”

Getty Images 
 He added: “It was only after [my band Try Star] sang an awkward performance of ‘Swing Low, Sweet Chariot’ and she kindly saved us in the show that we, as a band, went up to her dressing room to thank her. That was the first time I met her, and I’ve never looked back.”

Three years later, the former rugby player popped the question . Scherzinger teased that the pair were planning on having a wedding in her native Hawaii with a reception in Europe.

“The reception will be somewhere in Europe.…

He later experienced a dream sequence where he spoke with Jill about past inappropriate behavior — and his attempt to kill his mom in his head actually led to him accidentally murdering Chase ( John Stamos ).

Cutter wanted to highlight the idea that Brad was working through how his relationship with his mother affected his dating history, adding, “In his mind, he certainly feels a certain type of way about it because he conjured that dream sequence. items.title: Hayden Panettiere's Ex Brian Hickerson 'Distraught' After Her Death
items.summary:
The brother of Hayden Panettiere ’s on-off boyfriend, Brian Hickerson , is sharing an update on how he is doing following her tragic death in August .

“I spent almost eight to 10 weeks up in Greenville [South Carolina] around him,” Zach Hickerson said in an interview with TMZ published on Friday, November 27. “One word that comes to mind is just distraught, heartbroken, confused. I know that there’s still a certain level of shock and surrealness to him of that. There’s just no resolve to this. This isn’t, like, a legal thing. This isn’t a breakup thing. … It’s a definitive thing, and there’s no fixing [it]. There’s no resolve.”

“He’s, one, navigating the loss [and] two … trying to look ahead at the next chapter of his life or the rest of his life. Like, what now?” Zach, 39, continued. “Given all that’s happened, given the reputation, I just know that he’s carrying a lot. Rightfully so, to an extent.”

Panettiere was pronounced dead at the scene after authorities responded to a 911 call at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16. The Heroes actress was staying at the residence with Brian, 37. Zach was also present.

Brother of Hayden Panettiere's Ex Recalls Her Last Moments Before Death 

“I know that he’s heartbroken,” Zach shared on Friday. “I’ve tried to be there as much as I can for him. About three or four weeks ago, I realized that, man, I was probably trying to carry a little bit too much for everyone else and had not really dealt with the grief and loss myself. So I’ve taken the last two to three weeks to really kind of be on my own, so it’s hard for…

Princess Kate Middleton has been named patron of leading cancer hospital The Christie more than two years after going public with her own cancer battle .

Kensington Palace said in a statement on Friday, November 27, “The announcement follows Her Royal Highness’s visit to The Christie’s Withington site in June 2026, where she met patients, families and staff and learned more about the hospital’s internationally renowned approach to supporting people living with and beyond cancer.”

The Christie in Manchester, England, is one of the world’s leading cancer treatment centers and the largest of its kind in Europe.

“The patronage reflects the Princess of Wales’s longstanding interest in the role that emotional, social and physical well-being play in cancer patients’ journeys, and her commitment to highlighting the importance of holistic care alongside world-class clinical treatment,” Kensington Palace said. “Building on her recent work exploring recovery, resilience and life beyond diagnosis, the patronage reflects a shared belief in supporting the whole person throughout their cancer journey and beyond.”

Judge Derek Hough praised Frech’s expert recovery following the mishap during his freestyle on the Tuesday, November 24, season finale.

items.summary:
Dolly Parton ’s niece Danielle Parton  is honoring her late aunt this Thanksgiving.

Danielle, 50, paid tribute to Dolly on the first holiday since the “Jolene” singer’s death in August via a touching video shared on social media on Thursday, November 26.

“This year looks a little different from my family,” Danielle said in the video uploaded to Instagram. “We’re missing someone very special at the table. But Aunt Granny taught us to count our blessings, and I have so many.”

Danielle — who is the daughter of Bobby Lee Parton and Doris Maxine Noland — said she was grateful for her loved ones and well-wishers sending the family support after enduring a tough year.

“I’m thankful for my health, for all the people in my life, and for every one of you who sent so much love my way this year,” Danielle added in her message. “So hug your people a little tighter today, and from my home to yours, happy Thanksgiving.”

One day prior, U2 honored the memory of Dolly with a posthumous duet at the NFL’s Thanksgiving Eve game.

The Irish rockers projected archival footage and audio of Dolly for a hybrid live performance of their collaborative track “Torn” at the Green Bay Packers and Los Angeles Rams’ game on Wednesday, November 25.

items.summary:

In a sweet Instagram post uploaded on Thursday, November 26, Jen, 27, Zac, 30, and their three kids got involved in the beach picnic gender reveal. (Jen and Zac are already parents to daughters Nora, 5, and Penelope, 16 months, and son Luca, 3.)

The family cut into a cake with wine glasses, revealing that Jen and Zac are expecting another daughter.

“Our story may be changing, but the love we have for our babies never will. 🤍we love you baby girl,” the caption accompanying the post read.

Months later, the duo dropped the bombshell that they had split, with Jen filing for divorce on November 3 after seven years of marriage.

Jen exclusively told Us on November 10 that her pregnancy was one of the catalysts that led her to choose to end her marriage, insisting that “the same reason why I filed for divorce is the same reason why it was really hard.”

“It was this fourth child. I had to ask myself very hard questions like, ‘Is this the type of relationship I want this child to look up to?’” she told Us . “When I realized it was a no, that’s when I realized that I needed to make a change.
